dataset.title: DE Africa · Annual fractional cover
dataset.description: Landsat-derived annual statistics of modelled green vegetation, non-green vegetation and bare soil, distributed as complete original African tiles. Component percentiles are independent summaries, not one simultaneous observation.
dataset.version: DE Africa v1.0.0 · annual 2025 published grid recipe
dataset.attribution: Digital Earth Africa / Geoscience Australia; Fractional Cover algorithms by the Joint Remote Sensing Research Program. Retain Scarth et al. (2010), the exact publisher item, component/percentile, year and access date.
dataset.valueInterpretation: Original numerical samples; inspect the selected layer metadata. No automatic scientific conversion is applied.

Green vegetation, non-green vegetation and bare-soil percentiles are estimated independently and must not be added as a simultaneous cover composition. Values above the nominal range are retained.

This connector resolves candidate 2025 annual item filenames on the 96 km published EPSG:6933 grid; file existence and real publisher metadata are checked when connecting. The candidate African envelope is not a guarantee of availability, land coverage or scientific validity. No different tile, year or product is substituted.

The actual calendar-year interval is declared in the original dtr:start_datetime/dtr:end_datetime properties. The standard datetime is a reference instant, not a single-scene acquisition. Both fields and all original publisher properties remain unchanged.

Original asset filenames are relative to the actual HTTPS .stac-item.json directory. The publisher's S3 self link names a different .json suffix; revalidation uses the exact reviewed HTTPS item. This is a scoped filename recipe, not general private S3 access or fabricated collection metadata.

Complete original tiles are retained, with native pixel grids and embedded masks. The requested geographic area selects files without clipping or reprojecting them. A raw grayscale preview applies no palette, scientific calibration or component recombination.
limits: Up to 8 candidate 96 km tiles per selection; narrow larger requests. The fixed candidate envelope is 26°W–65°E, 40°S–40°N; only actual published African files can connect. Current recipe is version 1.0.0, year 2025.

Each complete original remains subject to the 512 MiB transfer limit and existing native TIFF decoding budgets. Absent or invalid metadata fails explicitly, without background file jobs or fallback products.

Each complete original remains subject to the 512 MiB transfer limit and existing native TIFF decoding budgets. Absent or invalid metadata fails explicitly, without background file jobs or fallback products.

Each complete original remains subject to the 512 MiB transfer limit and existing native TIFF decoding budgets. Absent or invalid metadata fails explicitly, without background file jobs or fallback products.

Complete original tiles are retained, with native pixel grids and embedded masks. The requested geographic area selects files without clipping or reprojecting them. A raw grayscale preview applies no palette, scientific calibration or component recombination.
limits: Up to 8 candidate 96 km tiles per selection; narrow larger requests. The fixed candidate envelope is 26°W–65°E, 40°S–40°N; only actual published African files can connect. Current recipe is version 1.0.0, year 2025.

Each complete original remains subject to the 512 MiB transfer limit and existing native TIFF decoding budgets. Absent or invalid metadata fails explicitly, without background file jobs or fallback products.

The complete continental distribution file is downloaded without cropping. Other CGLS assets remain unsupported by this scoped connector, including several originals over 512 MiB. A successful permanent-water file test does not validate the complete land-cover family, all years, scientific accuracy or every pixel in the requested area.

The tested file has original NoData 255 and overviews generated with bilinear resampling. A grayscale preview may use an embedded overview; raw pixel inspection reads image zero. Do not infer classification styling, calibrated values or full-resolution samples from the thumbnail.
limits: One original permanent-water cover-fraction file per reference year. Its actual grid is 91,587 × 87,011, or 7,969,076,457 pixels, just below the existing 8-billion-pixel tiled-raster bound.

Original transfers remain limited to 512 MiB. Tiled TIFF axes are limited to 131,072; stripped axes remain limited to 65,536. Native review retains 128 MiB chunk, 32 MiB intermediate, 512 MiB preview-budget and 30-second bounds. Published availability does not bypass those limits.

Original asset filenames are relative to the actual HTTPS .stac-item.json directory. The publisher's S3 self link names a different .json suffix; revalidation uses the exact reviewed HTTPS item. This is a scoped filename recipe, not general private S3 access or fabricated collection metadata.

Complete original tiles are retained, with native pixel grids and embedded masks. The requested geographic area selects files without clipping or reprojecting them. A raw grayscale preview applies no palette, scientific calibration or component recombination.
limits: Up to 8 candidate 96 km tiles per selection; narrow larger requests. The fixed candidate envelope is 26°W–65°E, 40°S–40°N; only actual published African files can connect. Current recipe is version 1.0.0, year 2025.

Each complete original remains subject to the 512 MiB transfer limit and existing native TIFF decoding budgets. Absent or invalid metadata fails explicitly, without background file jobs or fallback products.

datasets.title: DE Africa · Annual water observations
datasets.description: Annual Landsat Water Observations from Space summaries: wet and clear observation counts and their original water-frequency grid. This is an observed annual frequency model, not present water extent, depth or an automatically detected flood.
datasets.version: DE Africa v1.0.0 · annual 2025 published grid recipe
datasets.attribution: Digital Earth Africa / Geoscience Australia; Water Observations from Space (WOfS), Mueller et al. (2016), Remote Sensing of Environment 174, 341–352. Retain the publisher item, year, selected measurement and access date.
datasets.valueInterpretation: Original numerical samples; inspect the selected layer metadata. No automatic scientific conversion is applied.

layers.title: Annual water observation frequency
layers.valueInterpretation: Original Float32 frequency of wet observations among clear observations. NaN is embedded NoData, not zero water. A valid zero means clear observations without detected water. No conversion to percent is applied.

layers.title: Wet observation count
layers.valueInterpretation: Original count of observations classified as water, not water area or depth. Clear and wet counts have their own TIFF NoData declaration.

layers.title: Clear observation count
layers.valueInterpretation: Original count of clear observations. Zero clear observations provide no frequency estimate; the original frequency file retains NaN rather than a fabricated dry-land value.

warnings: WOfS frequency and observation counts are distinct measurements. Original NaN/missing-data pixels are retained; lack of clear observations is not evidence of dry land. Classification and cloud/terrain effects limit interpretation; raw pixels do not establish local accuracy or full valid-area coverage.

datasets.title: World Settlement Footprint · DE Africa public tiles
datasets.description: Historical settlement extent from DLR's WSF2015 v2 and WSF2019 v1, accessed through the actual Digital Earth Africa public regional tile archive. This is a binary settlement footprint, not raw satellite reflectance, building outlines or current population.
datasets.version: WSF2015 v2 / WSF2019 v1 · reviewed DE Africa publisher-item index 2026-10-12
datasets.attribution: German Aerospace Center (DLR), WSF2015 v2 / WSF2019 v1; contains processed Landsat/Copernicus Sentinel observations. Public African distribution: Digital Earth Africa. Cite the selected epoch, item, version, tile and access date; retain CC BY 4.0 attribution.
datasets.nominalResolution: approximately 10 m (0.00008983152841195215 degree); retain each original's actual grid and edge overlap
datasets.valueInterpretation: Original binary mask codes: 255 settlement, 0 background. Reviewed original files do not have an embedded TIFF NoData tag, so 0 and 255 remain readable raw samples. ODC fill conventions do not rewrite the original's missing-data declaration. Historical inferred settlement extent is not an individual-building or population census.

layers.title: Historical settlement footprint
layers.valueInterpretation: 255 settlement; 0 background. No inferred conversion to 0/1, no imposed NoData value, and no claim of raw satellite reflectance.

warnings: Only the actual listed DE Africa regional distribution is supported: 771 reviewed publisher tiles for each of 2015 and 2019, including some adjacent-region tiles. It is not a global WSF mirror. An unsupported year/month or an area with no matching published tile fails explicitly; no alternate area or epoch is substituted.

WSF settlement is encoded as 255. The independently decoded 2015/2019 originals have no TIFF NoData tag: native zero-background reads remain noData=false. The ODC documentation's fill value 0 is a separate loading convention and must not silently alter original TIFF samples.

Actual tile dimensions and padding vary by tile (including 22,487/22,488 pixel axes). Preserve publisher shape/transform and the real edge overlap; do not replace the footprint with a nominal 2-degree rectangle or assume identical grids between different files.

Publisher item assets use original s3 URLs. Only this preset's exact pinned bucket/path receives the fixed public HTTPS transport; archived publisher JSON and original asset declarations remain unchanged. No private bucket, signed URL or AWS account is involved.

Standalone items have no STAC collection/license link. CC BY 4.0 is separately documented by DLR/DE Africa, not an invented publisher collection declaration. A complete tile download is not clipped to the map area; bbox intersection and a grayscale preview are not verified valid-settlement coverage or accuracy.
limits: At most 8 actual intersecting publisher tiles per selection; narrow larger areas. The complete original tile is downloaded without clipping.

Each original remains limited to 512 MiB. Existing tiled-axis (131,072), grid-pixel (8 billion), stripped-axis (65,536), chunk/intermediate/preview-budget and deadline guards remain unchanged. Metadata connection is not full-original download acceptance.

datasets.title: Global Mangrove Watch v3 · DE Africa coastal tiles
datasets.description: Historical mangrove extent from Global Mangrove Watch v3, accessed through Digital Earth Africa's public regional coastal tiles for 2017–2020. This thematic mangrove mask is not optical imagery, biomass or a blue-carbon estimate.
datasets.version: GMW v3.0 · 2017–2020 DE Africa tiled archive · reviewed publisher-item index 2026-10-12
datasets.attribution: Global Mangrove Watch / Aberystwyth University, soloEO, Wetlands International, UNEP-WCMC and JAXA; Bunting et al. (2022), GMW Version 3.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6894273. African tiled distribution: Digital Earth Africa. Retain CC BY 4.0 attribution and cite the actual year, version and item.
datasets.nominalResolution: approximately 25 m (0.000222222222222 degree v3 tile grid); not the older continental 0.0002-degree grid
datasets.valueInterpretation: Original mangrove mask: 1 mangrove, 0 background/fill. Reviewed v3 files embed TIFF NoData=0; the native missing-data flag follows that original declaration. Since background and missing data share the original zero code, zero does not establish valid non-mangrove observations. This is historical modeled extent rather than raw reflectance, biomass or measured carbon.

layers.title: Historical mangrove extent
layers.valueInterpretation: 1 mangrove; 0 background/fill and embedded TIFF NoData. Preserve the original code and mask; zero cannot prove valid non-mangrove coverage.

warnings: Only the 249 actual DE Africa regional coastal v3 tiles per year for 2017–2020 are reviewed, including some adjacent-region tiles. This is not a global mirror despite the product name. Unsupported years/months or map areas with no available coastal tile fail explicitly; no sample coastline is substituted.

The old 1996–2016 continental originals have 454,300 × 431,600 pixel grids and exceed current native axis/grid limits even though their compressed byte size is under 512 MiB. They are excluded; this connector uses the real v3 one-degree tiles without increasing resource limits.

Actual v3 tiles have approximately 0.000222222222222 degree grid cells, different from the older documentation's continental 0.0002-degree grid. Most grids are 4,500 × 4,500; the eastern N26E064 archive edge has 4,500 rows × 2,250 columns and a half-degree footprint. Original shape, transform, footprint and embedded NoData are retained; do not promise exact 20 m spatial detail or impose another product's grid or mask.

Mangrove 1 is a positive modeled class. Zero is both background/fill and the original TIFF missing-data declaration, so an all-zero or transparent thumbnail is not evidence of useful coverage. A positive raw value, bbox intersection or map overlay does not validate mangrove accuracy or change detection.

limits: At most 8 actual intersecting publisher tiles per selection; narrow larger areas. The complete original tile is downloaded without clipping.
